description.value: A locally owned health food and wellness shop that has been operating in downtown Hope, BC for 30 years. The store carries a wide variety of spices, loose and bagged herbal teas, a refillery station for soaps and essential oils, and specialty items like Darn Tough socks and hand-woven African baskets. Located on the Trans-Canada corridor, it offers a distinctive browsing stop though it is more of a specialty wellness shop than a conventional grocery.
